title: Residual-selected shared SAE basis with behavior-specific sparse codes
hypothesis: On four held-out relation behaviors in pinned Pythia-70m, a shared 64-atom SAE basis selected by residual reduction on tasks 0-11 and 16-coefficient behavior codes will preserve explicit-FV quality within .10 gold-logprob nats/.05 accuracy, use <=.95x the actual bytes of global per-behavior SAE OMP16 lists, and beat the same-size aggregate-activation pool OMP16 control by >=.10 nats on both development seeds.
physical_object: Pinned Pythia-70m and pretrained tied 2048-atom layer-3 SAE dictionary.
mirror_coordinate: Per-behavior 16-term sparse coefficient code indexed into one shared fit-selected 64-atom SAE pool.
logical_multiplicity: Sixteen support-derived relation interventions represented as sparse behavior codes over one shared feature pool; heldout behaviors 12-15 were excluded from pool selection.

artifacts.tasks: Reuse MA-516 task sets, support splits, layer-4 FVs and causal evaluator.

task.primary_metric: mean held-out gold candidate log probability

view.pool_selection: Initialize residuals to the 12 fit-task FVs. For 64 rounds choose the SAE encoder atom with maximum summed absolute normalized correlation to current residuals over tasks 0-11; stable lowest-index tie break; greedily subtract each task's projection. No heldout vectors contribute.
view.behavior_code: Run deterministic signed matching pursuit for exactly 16 distinct atoms from the selected 64-atom pool for each task; coefficients are FP32. Stable argmax tie break. Decode as the sum of selected SAE atom rows times coefficients.
view.selection: No rank, pool size, atom count or threshold tuning.

controls: Per-behavior global SAE signed OMP16 sparse lists over all 2048 atoms
Aggregate positive SAE-activation top64 pool plus OMP16 (MA-526 selection baseline at matched code sparsity)

fresh.opening_rule: Only if both dev seeds meet explicit-FV quality, actual-byte and aggregate-pool attribution gates.

paid_objects: full SAE artifact for standalone deployment
all explicit and native sparse control lists
storage.accounting: Report code bytes over preloaded SAE and standalone Pythia+SAE totals versus Pythia+explicit FV and Pythia+global SAE OMP16. No decoded vectors are cached.

compute.active_compute_proxy: Report shared-basis residual correlation/subtraction, per-task OMP16 over pool vs global SAE dictionary and transformer query sequences separately.

gates.PASS: Both seeds: within .05 accuracy/.10 gold-logprob nats of explicit FV, shared-pool payload <=.95x global OMP16 sparse-list payload, and >=.10 gold-logprob nats better than aggregate-top64 OMP16.
gates.FAIL: Any frozen quality, byte, or attribution gate is missed.
gates.NOT_ESTABLISHED: Pinned artifact, split integrity, or deterministic replay fails.

boundaries: One SAE checkpoint and four heldout relation tasks only.
This is a fixed-support code/representation screen, not a capacity claim.
Charge full SAE bytes for standalone use.
The global and aggregate-pool sparse lists are required direct controls.
